description: Clicks, impressions, CTR (0–1) and average position from Google Search, grouped by date, query, page, country, device or search appearance, with filters and paging. Defaults: last 28 days of final data, web search, 100 rows sorted by clicks. Search Console data typically lags 2–3 days; the default range ends 3 days ago (Pacific Time). Pass data_state "all" to include fresher, still-changing data. Grouping or filtering by query omits anonymised (rare) queries, so query rows add up to less than the totals by date, country or device. Google exposes at most 50,000 rows per day per search type.

aggregation_type.description: "auto" (default): by property, or by page when grouping/filtering by page. "byPage" counts each URL separately (totals differ from by property).

data_state.description: "final" (default): only finished days. "all": include fresh, still-changing data. "hourly_all": needed for the "hour" dimension.

dimensions.description: Group by these, e.g. ["query"], ["page"], ["date"], ["query", "page"]. None: one row with the property totals. "hour" needs data_state "hourly_all".

expression.description: Value to match. country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, lowercase (e.g. "pol", "usa"); device: "DESKTOP", "MOBILE" or "TABLET"; page: a full URL.

operator.description: Default "equals". Regex operators use RE2 syntax.

search_type.description: Default "web". "discover" and "googleNews" don't support grouping by query or aggregation_type "byProperty".

site_url.description: Search Console property exactly as list_sites shows it: "sc-domain:example.com" for a domain property, or a URL prefix with its trailing slash, e.g. "https://www.example.com/".

start_row.description: Zero-based row offset for paging (use next_start_row from a previous result).
